edges: Conan recognizes Jungir almost immediately.
She promises Conan position and wealth in exchange for taking an antidote to Jungir.
Conan rescues the woman from the High priest.
Conan defeats Baal-pteor at his own game.
Conan returns to Aquilonia after a long quest to dispose of his foes.
Conan is the King of Aquilonia during the time when Xaltotun is resurrected.
Bêlit orders her crew to kill Conan, but Conan agrees to raid the Black Coast with her.
Conan is fleeing from the civil authorities of Argos due to a court dispute.
Conan has no previous experience or knowledge of the sea.
Conan tries to rally the crew after the captain was killed
Conan jumps aboard the pirate ship
Bêlit promises to remain with Conan even after death
Conan threatens the captain and crew with his sword when they object to his demand to travel without paying.
The captain agrees to let Conan stay on board because it would be useful to have a fighting man on the voyage.
Conan tries to rally the crew after the captain was killed
Conan manages to jump aboard the pirate ship
Bêlit offers Conan the chance to sail with her and be her chosen mate.
Conan refuses Bêlit's offer.
Conan and Bêlit raid the Black Coast together.
Conan gives Bêlit a Viking funeral

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: In a twisted mental state, Bêlit issues faulty orders
Bêlit is hanged by the winged monster
Bêlit is captivated by a cursed jeweled necklace
The High priest forces the woman to dance until she dies.
